liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd69-05-11.fm.cotsman.6296.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 73 min; rated 2.8/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is shaky with many cuts, though the performance was strong [9]
- **gd1969-05-11.158656.FM.miller.flac1648**: FM broadcast; 6 songs; 72 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Live broadcast on KPRI 106.5; reviewer worked for KDEO; highlight was a Dead/Santana jam [6]
- Reviewer asks if anyone recorded video of the concert, noting they attended [7]
- Santana, then the Santana Blues Band, joined the Dead as their members gradually left [8]
- Bill included Canned Heat and Tarantula; Santana’s first major San Diego appearance [8]
- Very warm day; bill included Tarantula, Lee Michaels, and drummer Frosty [10]
- Santana Blues Band was mind-boggling; reviewer found the Dead set unimpressive at the time [10]
- Reviewer attended the Aztec Bowl show on May 11, 1969, their birthday [11]
- Seven-minute video exists with New Potato Caboose dubbed over; Jerry is fired up [12]
- Material duplicates the Santa Barbara May 29, 1969 performance, causing date confusion [3]
- This recording is more muffled and has worse sound quality than the Santa Barbara version [4]
- This show is much more muddy than the Santa Barbara recording of the same material [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-05-11.fm.cotsman.6296.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Paul Hartman and J. Cotsman; source: FM Soundboard [1]. Also: Circulated as May 29, 1969, but likely from May 11; radio announcer heard during Cryptical [1]
- **gd1969-05-11.158656.FM.miller.flac1648**: taped by Matthew Zavislak for the DAT; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 14, 2022; source: FM (KPRI) > Cassette Master > ? > DAT (48k) [2]. Also: Thanks to Matthew Zavislak for DAT; Mike Babyak for pitch correction input [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Aztec Bowl, San Diego Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1969/artwork/aztec-bowl-san-diego-poster) [16]
- Fan art by Concertposterauction.com: [Grateful Dead Canned Heat Santana Aztec Bowl San Diego 1969 AOR 3.102 Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/724334/Grateful-Dead-Canned-Heat-Santana-Aztec-Bowl-San-Diego-1969-AOR-3102-Poster) [17]
